policy.scope: Cross-source declaration drift for Material Web modules that overlap the Compose canonical corpus.
policy.rule: A Material Web mismatch may only be reconciled as documented drift when the pinned alternate source and implementation evidence are recorded here. Exact semantic remaps do not count as drift.
policy.canonicalIntent: Preserve effective Material 3 behavior while retaining generated-source provenance; do not overwrite implementation-derived canonical values merely to make a secondary-source declaration gate green.

drift.reason: Pinned Compose ButtonDefaults explicitly hard-codes ExtraSmallIconSpacing to 4.dp and marks the generated ButtonXSmallTokens value TODO for correction. The canonical token models the effective implementation value, while the generated-source discrepancy remains visible here.

Pinned Compose ButtonDefaults explicitly hard-codes extra-small content start padding to 12.dp with a TODO to update once ButtonXSmallTokens is corrected; Material Web 34.0.21 independently agrees at 12px.

Pinned Compose ButtonDefaults explicitly hard-codes extra-small content end padding to 12.dp with a TODO to update once ButtonXSmallTokens is corrected; Material Web 34.0.21 independently agrees at 12px.

semanticRemaps.reason: Material Web selected-container-shape-round names the selected shape by the source round state and resolves to the square counterpart. Compose ToggleButton resolves checkedShape to the square target (ContainerShapeSquare / SelectedContainerShapeSquare). The apparent name/value inversion is a source-vs-target naming convention, not a behavioral disagreement.
